reconcile.note: Adam Clarke reads Joshua 24:9's 'warred' as Balak's efforts via Balaam's curses rather than literal battle, matching Jephthah's denial of any fighting.

sides.snippet: Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel
sides.verseText: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel: and he sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you;

sides.snippet: did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
sides.verseText: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
